reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The Bank has invested USD 75 million under Türkiye GEFF II framework in a USD 750 million Basel III compliant Tier-2 ("B3T2") bond issued by Türkiye Garanti Bankasi A.S. ("GB"), a commercial bank incorporated in Türkiye. The bond is publicly offered and listed on the Irish Stock Exchange. The project will support GB in further strengthening its capitalisation, via decreasing capital sensitivity to TRY exchange rate volatility as well as supporting its funding diversification strategy, ultimately contributing to the resilience of the overall Turkish banking sector. Furthermore, GB will allocate 210% of EBRD`s investment amount to projects which meet the GET eligibility criteria, in line with the Türkiye GEFF II Framework. GB will finance sub-borrowers implementing green economy investments in a gender responsive way, including, among others, energy efficiency, renewable energy and climate resilience measures, and additional green investment areas focusing on nature and biodiversity, blue economy, as well as sustainable agriculture, transport and tourism.
